generations.name: Launch (7 kW AC)
generations.notes: 90 kWh LG Chem pack, 100 kW DC (CCS1), 7 kW single-phase on-board charger. North American deliveries from Oct 2018 (MY2019). A Dec 2019 software update raised EPA range from 234 to 246 mi, which can change curves within this entry. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jaguar_I-Pace ; https://www.cars.com/articles/2022-jaguar-i-pace-436736

generations.name: Update (11 kW AC)
generations.notes: Same 90 kWh pack and 100 kW DC; on-board charger raised to 11 kW, new Pivi Pro infotainment. Europe got it for MY2021 (from Jun 2020); the US skipped MY2021 and got it for MY2022 (Engadget, Cars.com), although EPA lists a MY2021 "EV400" rating. NRCan has no MY2021 row. Production ended in 2024. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.engadget.com/jaguar-2022-i-pace-ev-154517094.html ; https://www.cars.com/articles/2022-jaguar-i-pace-436736 ; https://insideevs.com/news/430211/2021-jaguar-i-pace-improved/
